description:
Great opportunity to purchase a rental property with tenant already in situ. Having good sized rooms throughout and being within a superb location close to shops and the local coastline, this property is ready to view and is ideal for landlords. The accommodation in brief comprises: entrance vestibule, living room, large kitchen/dining room, inner hallway/utility room and bathroom. To the first floor are three bedrooms. The main bedroom is a large double, the second is a good sized double and the third is a useful single. Outside to the front the property has on street parking. To the rear is an enclosed yard with gate.

ENTRANCE VESTIBULE With staircase to first floor.

LIVING ROOM 12' 11" x 13' 0" (3.94m x 3.98m) Good sized room with fireplace and window to front.

KITCHEN/DINING ROOM 14' 6" x 11' 9" (4.42m x 3.59m) Large room with storage cupboards, window to rear, breakfast bar, fitted units, space for freestanding cooker and other appliances, sink unit and doorway into:

REAR PORCH/UTILITY Space for additional appliances and door to rear yard.

BATHROOM Mostly tiled with window to side and fitted with suite comprising bath with overhead shower and screen, toilet and sink.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING

BEDROOM ONE 14' 5" x 12' 1" (4.40m x 3.70m) Great sized double room with window to front.

BEDROOM TWO 11' 0" x 7' 8" (3.36m x 2.35m) Double room with window to rear.

BEDROOM THREE 8' 4" x 7' 6" (2.56m x 2.30m) Single room with window to rear.

EXTERNALLY To the front the property has on street parking. To the rear is an enclosed yard with gate.

GENERAL INFORMATION Council Tax - Band A Please note all measurements including floorplans are approximate only.
